_SIGNAL_CANDIDATE_comment: leading_cluster: one candidate per signal interaction (largest-Charge cluster) carrying the Truth-tree event weight, sum preserved; per_cluster: legacy, every cluster weighted (fragments dilute the event weight). lib/weights.py assign_signal_event_weights.
_SELECTED_ADJCL_PADDING_BUG_comment: Diagnostic only: true re-creates the pre-c01e61a SelectedAdjClNum (zero padding counted) to measure the effect of the fix. Never true for results.

NEUTRON_CAPTURE_VETO._doc: 03_analysis.py: in the listed analyses, clusters with ENERGY_MIN <= analysis energy < ENERGY_MAX whose main cluster Energy is below MAIN_CLUSTER_ENERGY_MIN are removed. Neutron-capture cascades share their 6.1 MeV among several clusters, so a small main cluster with a large reconstructed energy is mostly a capture (HD Central, new PIC backgrounds, cluster-level study 2026-10-09: DayNight +4/+8% on the two event halves). On by default only for ENABLED_CONFIGS; the study variant ncveto switches it on for any config. Adopted for every config after rerun 15 (study ncveto, cuts re-optimised): DayNight / Sensitivity at 30 years HD Central 3.93->4.05 / 3.20->3.41, HD Lateral 1.08->1.09 / 0.59->0.66, VD Top 1.25->1.32 / 0.40->0.44, VD Shielded 3.52->3.64 / 2.66->3.05.

PER_CONFIG._doc: Per-config veto (overrides the defaults above). MODE classifier: the neutron-capture classifier (03b --target ncap) removes the clusters of its 6-14 MeV region scored below the threshold of COMPLETENESS (CC kept in the region); chosen from the cluster-level test on the rerun 17 state (2026-10-10, both event halves; DayNight / Sensitivity-selection day-night significance at 50%: HD Central +20% / +38%, HD Lateral +13% / +6%, VD Top +23% / +22%). VD Shielded keeps the window rule [8,12) MeV, main cluster < 4.5 MeV (classifier <= +5%).

MC_THRESHOLDS_PER_CONFIG._doc: Per-config MC-statistics requirements (run_sensitivity.py), replacing ANALYSIS_THRESHOLDS MC and the 03_analysis per-bin filter (2) for these configs. Chosen from the mcgate study (2026-10-10, rerun 17 state): HD Central with the gates divided by 5 (20/5/5, user's choice) and a 1-event per-bin filter (HEP 6.25 -> 13.74, DayNight 4.92 -> 5.06, Sensitivity 3.20 -> 3.37 sigma/dchi2 at 30 y), HD Lateral with the 50/10 gates (HEP 2.49 -> 3.34). VD unchanged (looser settings were equal or lower). Results under these settings rest on fewer simulated background events; see the study for the MC support.
